name: Can a wet carpet without a visible leak lead to mold?

mainEntity.name: Can a wet carpet without a visible leak lead to mold?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, absolutely. Even seemingly small amounts of moisture can lead to mold growth if not addressed quickly and thoroughly. Mold can start to grow within 24-48 hours in damp conditions. Beyond visible damage, mold can cause musty odors and potentially affect indoor air quality. This is why prompt detection, water extraction, and proper drying by professionals are critical to mitigate mold risks.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, wet carpet can lead to mold growth within 24-48 hours. Prompt detection and drying are critical to prevent it.
